cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Dad, will you come to my opening? Even for ten minutes? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know anything about sculpture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You survived every school play. I still want you in my corner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your mother will be there. We haven't spoken since the divorce.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come before we open. I'll unpack the biggest piece with you. I want a memory of tonight with you in it too.

mechanism: A directs an opening and confidently assigns Dad a place, then changes access and tasks to keep his involvement as evidence of connection.
confusable: Unlike seeking an art opinion, A wants Dad there personally; borrowed authority yields the visit timing and task while preserving the organizer voice.
comparison: Public exhibition with parental discomfort differs from siblings sharing an unfinished family kitchen.
seedUse: Use D73-b sculpture/opening/divorce/unpacking and S02-b adapting the method to keep a participant willing.
